info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Release Management API
info.description: The Settlement Release Management API facilitates the secure release of financial settlements identified by their unique settlement ID. Through this API, users can initiate the release process for pending settlements, ensuring timely disbursement and operational efficiency. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment processors, this API supports streamlined settlement management and integration within automated processing workflows. It provides essential capabilities for handling transaction lifecycles and enhances financial accountability in settlement operations.

post.description: This operation releases the settlement associated with the resource identifier RES-100045, making it available for further processing or actions. It is essential for managing settled resources effectively.
